title: Holiness of God
definition: The holiness of God is the truth that God is perfectly pure, righteous, morally flawless, and utterly set apart from all sin, corruption, and evil.
summary: God is perfectly pure, righteous, and set apart from all sin, corruption, and imperfection.
christFocus: Jesus perfectly reveals God's holiness through His sinless life, His obedience to the Father, His hatred of evil, and His saving work that cleanses sinners.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
God's holiness means He is set apart in majesty and perfect in moral purity. He is not like fallen humanity. There is no darkness, impurity, injustice, or compromise in Him. His holiness is not one small part of who He is; it marks all His ways.

Because God is holy, sin is serious. Sin is not merely a mistake, weakness, or personal struggle; it is rebellion against the holy God. Scripture shows that when people truly glimpse God's holiness, they are humbled, convicted, and made aware of their need for mercy.

The holiness of God also magnifies the grace of the Gospel. In Christ, the holy God provides cleansing for sinners without denying His righteousness. Jesus is the spotless Savior who brings unholy people near to God through His blood.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Many people treat sin lightly because they have a small view of God. Understanding God's holiness awakens reverence, repentance, worship, and gratitude. It shows why grace is necessary, why the cross matters, and why believers are called to holy lives.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Ask God to give you a higher view of His holiness and a more honest view of sin. Confess what His Word exposes, trust Christ for cleansing, and pursue holiness not as self-righteous performance but as grateful obedience to the holy Lord who saved you.
